title: TAT-3845 perps-controller 15.1.0 bump
description: Proves the extension declares, resolves, bundles, and runs @metamask/perps-controller 15.1.0: the manifest range and resolved package are 15.1.0, the built extension bundle carries a symbol that only exists from 13.0.0 onward, the repo typechecks against the new PerpsErrorCode union, and the live Perps surfaces still render market data through the upgraded controller. Note on C3 routing: the perps home is reached with the semantic `page: perps` navigator, but the market list and market detail are reached by hash. The library's `page: perps-market-list` / `page: perps-market` navigators wait on `market-list-view` and `perps-market-detail-page` test ids that this build's UI does not render, so they time out regardless of this PR. That is a pre-existing harness/product test-id gap, not a regression from the controller bump; the surfaces themselves render and are asserted here.

market.description: Perps market opened to prove the upgraded controller still serves live market data.

timeout_ms.description: Per-navigation budget. Live Hyperliquid market data can take well over the 45s library default to populate the market list on a cold cache.

gate-doctor.intent: Prove the extension adapter is attached before any claim is measured

ac1-read-manifest-range.intent: C1: the extension declares the 15.1.0 range, not the previous ^12.0.0

ac1-assert-resolved-version.intent: C1: the range actually resolves to 15.1.0 in the installed tree

ac1-assert-lockfile-resolution.intent: C1: the lockfile pins 15.1.0 so CI and every other checkout resolve the same version

ac1-grep-bundled-symbol.intent: C1: locate a PerpsErrorCode that exists only from controller 13.0.0 onward inside the built extension bundle

ac1-assert-bundled-symbol-exit.intent: C1: the grep found the post-12.x symbol, so the running bundle is not the old controller

ac1-assert-bundled-symbol-file.intent: C1: name the bundle file carrying the new controller code, so the match is not an empty pass

ac2-run-error-code-tests.intent: C2: exercise the PerpsErrorCode -> i18n exhaustiveness suite against the 15.1.0 union

ac2-assert-tests-count.intent: C2: a non-vacuous run — every test in the suite, including the new-code coverage case, actually executed

ac2-assert-new-codes-mapped.cmd: yarn jest ui/components/app/perps/utils/translate-perps-error.test.ts --no-coverage -t 'translates every error code introduced after v12' 2>&1
ac2-assert-new-codes-mapped.intent: C2: run only the case that names the five codes added in controller 13.0.0-15.1.0

ac2-assert-new-codes-selected.intent: C2: exactly one test matched the title filter and passed, so the run is not the vacuous zero-match pass that `jest -t` otherwise reports as success

ac2-run-typecheck.intent: C2: the repo typechecks against the widened PerpsErrorCode union and the rest of the 15.1.0 type surface

ac2-assert-typecheck-exit.intent: C2: zero type errors — the `satisfies Record<PerpsErrorCode, string>` constraint is met

ac3-open-perps.intent: C3: open the Perps home surface served by the upgraded controller

ac3-assert-perps-home.intent: C3: prove the Perps home surface renders live controller-backed state rather than an error or empty shell

ac3-open-market-list.intent: C3: show the user the full live Perps market selection served by the upgraded controller

ac3-wait-market-list.intent: C3: wait until two real markets are actually on screen, so the count assertion cannot pass against the eight loading placeholders the list shows before live data arrives

ac3-assert-market-list.intent: C3: prove the upgraded controller populates a live multi-market list containing the requested market. Surface is read as `auto` because this build's market list carries no `market-list-view` test id, so the detector labels it `unknown`; the market-list feature flag, the market rows and the requested symbol are asserted directly instead.

ac3-open-market.intent: C3: show the user the requested market's detail screen with its live pricing and statistics

ac3-wait-market-detail.intent: C3: let the live market price resolve before the detail surface is read

ac3-assert-market-details.intent: C3: prove live price, 24h change, market statistics and the candlestick chart all resolve through the 15.1.0 controller

ac3-clear-capture-orphans.intent: C3: clear orphaned capture-helper processes so the next capture cannot silently fall back to Page.captureScreenshot

ac3-wait-market-price.intent: C3: confirm the live market price element is on screen before the capture claims it is

ac3-capture-market.label: C3: ETH market detail renders live price, change and stats on perps-controller 15.1.0
ac3-capture-market.intent: C3: reviewer-visible proof that the Perps market surface still renders after the bump
